title: Lightly Smoky Dutch Lemongrass Skewers
description: A comforting and smoky vegan dish featuring lemongrass, this Dutch-inspired recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of lemongrass and smoky flavors creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium heat, about 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
Trim the lemongrass stalks to about 2 inches long and bruise them lightly with a spoon to release their oils.
Thread a piece of tofu, a piece of lemongrass, and a garlic clove onto each bamboo skewer.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Brush the paprika mixture evenly onto both sides of the tofu and lemongrass on the skewers.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for about 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tofu is lightly browned and the lemongrass is slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional lemongrass if desired.
